map.AT = 体感温度（温湿风综合）: AT = apparent temperature (combined temperature, humidity and wind)
map.→ 打开体感温度 AT工具: -> Open the apparent temperature AT tool
map.体感温度会高于实际温度吗？: Can apparent temperature be higher than the actual temperature?
map.和炎热指数区别？: How does it differ from the heat index?
map.对比干热与湿热体感差异。: Compare the felt difference between dry heat and humid heat.
map.无风无辐射时由气温与水汽压估体感。: With no wind and no radiation, the apparent temperature is estimated from air temperature and vapour pressure.
map.炎热指数（Heat Index）多用于高温高湿，本式是澳大利亚简化体感，适用区间: The heat index is used mainly for high temperature and high humidity; this formula is the simplified Australian apparent temperature and applies over a different range.
map.由气温、相对湿度与风速，按 Steadman 公式估算人体体感温度。: Estimate the apparent temperature from air temperature, relative humidity and wind speed using the Steadman formula.
map.输入气温、相对湿度与风速，按Steadman体感温度公式估算人体实际感受温度，用: Enter air temperature, relative humidity, and wind speed, then estimate the apparent temperature with the Steadman formula, for health alerts and clothing advice in hot and humid or wind-chill conditions.
map.高湿天解释「比实际更闷热」。: On humid days this explains why it feels "muggier than the actual temperature".
map.高湿无风时常高于实温（散热差）；有风时风寒效应又会低于实温，看主导因素。: With high humidity and no wind it is often above the actual temperature (poor heat loss); with wind the wind-chill effect pushes it below the actual temperature, so the dominant factor decides.
map.：30°C、相对湿度 70%：水汽压 e=0.7×6.105×exp(17.27: : 30°C at 70% relative humidity: vapor pressure e = 0.7×6.105×exp(17.27×30/(237.7+30)) ≈ 29.6 hPa; apparent temperature AT = 30+0.33×29.6−4.0 ≈ 35.8°C, clearly muggier than 30°C.
map.：同样 30°C 但湿度 30%：e≈12.7 hPa，AT=30+0.33×1: : At the same 30°C but 30% humidity: e ≈ 12.7 hPa, AT = 30+0.33×12.7−4 ≈ 30.2°C, close to the actual temperature, so the dry heat is not muggy.
